implementation: Gemplus GemXpresso Pro E64 PK - FIPS with ActivCard Applet Suite
description: The "GemXpresso Pro E64 PK - FIPS with ActivCard Applet Suite" is based on a Gemplus Open OS Smart Card (Java Card 2.1.1, OP 2.0.1, 64K of EEPROM), and on platform-independent cryptographic applets developed by ActivCard (ID, PKI, and GC applets). The card and applets provide authentication and digital signature cryptographic services to end-users.
